actions: Remove engine cover and access covers for the pre-cat sensors
canonicalStep.title: precat-sensor-connectors-engine-bay (BMW 328i draft Oxygen Sensor guide; evidence step 3, 4, 5)

elements.describe: The plastic engine cover held by three screws, shown lifted or removed.
Three screws that hold the engine cover.

Two sensor plugs (one per bank) on the right side of the engine above the exhaust manifold, each seated in a mounting bracket and joined to its sensor by a lead that runs in channels and clips under the engine cover.
A release tab on each plug that is pressed down to separate the halves after the plug is pulled up out of its bracket.
The top of the exhaust manifolds where the pre-cat sensors screw in.
